How to get it :
- [[Electrolyser|Electrolyser]] (x2) : [[gv:crystal_trixite|Trixite Crystals]].
- Crafting table (x6) : Neptunium Powder, Iodine Powder, Thorium Powder, Astatine Powder, Neodymium Powder, Caesium Powder.
- Crafting table (x6) : Strontium Powder, Cobalt Powder, Bromine Powder, Tennessine Powder, Niobium Powder, Cerium Powder.
(3 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:rad_absorber_pink|Elite Radiation Absorber]].
